posts.author: redguardx
posts.body: The default movement in RPG Maker MZ has a certain delay to it, characters don't turn immediately. The amount of animations for characters' movement is also limited, is there a way to make these things much smoother and more advanced? Or is it only solvable through plugins?

posts.author: Krimer
posts.body: It’s not really a delay - the movement is tile-based, each tile is 48x48, so the character has to fully finish moving to the next tile before it can turn. If you want to change that, you’ll need a pixel movement system plugin.
